definition: a hormone injected to control blood sugar
description: A young woman sits at a kitchen table by a window in morning light. She has long brown hair and a grey sweatshirt and holds up an insulin pen, checking the dose. She then lifts her sweatshirt, injects into her belly and looks at the pen again. On the table are a plate of rice and beans, an open blue cool bag holding two small glass vials, a blood sugar meter, a small plastic cap and a notebook with handwritten numbers. A young man sits behind her eating from a bowl and smiles at her.

de.answer: Sie spritzt sich Insulin in den Bauch.
de.question: Was macht die Frau gerade?

es.answer: Se está inyectando insulina en el vientre.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle s'injecte de l'insuline dans le ventre.
